evidence.reason: On a fresh host the two-slot/health path reads the prior heartbeat with `_tick_value(effects)` before the injected observation callback runs, and `health_observation` likewise parses the current tick immediately. With no `heartbeat.json` yet published this raises out of the health path instead of spending the first-tick timeout, so a runner that publishes within `--first-tick-timeout-seconds` still exits 2. The bounded `wait_for_first_tick` above has the same unguarded `health_observation` call. The smallest compatible fix is to treat an initially absent heartbeat as not-yet-advanced while waiting, still rejecting unreadable/foreign heartbeats and still requiring a second advancing tick; this is an ordinary correctness repair, not a disruptive architectural change.
